queries.query: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE departmentId = {departmentId} ORDER BY employeeId
SELECT employeeId, firstName, lastName, salary FROM employees WHERE salary >= {minSalary} ORDER BY salary DESC, employeeId

description: Raises the salary of every employee in a department (admin only).

queries.query: UPDATE employees SET salary = salary * (1 + {percentage} / 100) WHERE departmentId = {departmentId}
